bio.text: Christopher Lancia is the Republican nominee for Connecticut's 3rd Congressional District in 2026; CT Mirror says he won the nomination on a roll call vote at the convention.
According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Bridgeport, lives in Milford, and is a U.S. Coast Guard veteran and former federal law enforcement officer.

CT Mirror describes him as a former Coast Guardsman and police officer at the Naval Submarine Base New London who is now a manager at the fiber-network provider TNI; his campaign site says he holds a bachelor's degree in Emergency Management from Post University.
